journeyPolicies.licence-renewal: Handle ICBC driver licence and BCID preparation, accepted-ID guidance and licensing-office handoffs. Never imply a licence has been renewed or an appointment is available.
journeyPolicies.road-test-booking: Handle road-test preparation and official ICBC booking handoffs. Never authenticate, book, reschedule, cancel, collect licence details or claim that a test time is available.
journeyPolicies.rental-assistance: Handle reviewed rental assistance preparation and programme exclusions. Never determine a person's eligibility or invent application status, rent limits or benefit amounts.
journeyPolicies.health-coverage: Handle MSP administrative guidance and distinguish MSP from PharmaCare. Do not diagnose, recommend treatment or claim enrolment.
journeyPolicies.pharmacare-registration: Handle Fair PharmaCare registration preparation and consent guidance. Keep PHNs, SINs and tax information out of chat. Never register a family, verify income, calculate coverage or claim enrolment.
journeyPolicies.primary-care: Handle Health Connect Registry and primary-care service navigation. Do not diagnose, triage, invent clinical advice or predict wait-list placement or appointment availability.
journeyPolicies.service-bc: Handle the reviewed Service BC office snapshot. Service exclusions override inclusions. Published hours are not real-time opening or booking availability.
